missions.name: Break the Pirate Toll
missions.blurb: A toll beacon is blocking the lane, and the Gutter denies placing it.

win.text: Toll beacon destroyed · the lane is open

lose.text: The toll remains · its crew now recognise your ship

ignore.text: You take another route and leave the toll in place

won.text: The toll is gone · supplies cost less on this lane

lost.text: The toll remains · prices rise on this lane

missions.name: Nothing to Declare
missions.blurb: A runner needs medicine carried through a Custody patrol to the hospice ring.

goal.line: Reach the drop point without being detected

win.text: Medicine delivered · no patrol saw you

lose.text: The patrol detects you and turns to intercept

ignore.text: You take another route around the patrol

won.text: Medicine reached the hospice ring · the Gutter remembers

lost.text: The patrol caught the drop · the lane is under tighter watch

missions.name: Follow the Cyrite Vein
missions.blurb: A prospector found a vein, and Gutter scouts want it.

goal.line: Guard the prospector to her vein

threat.say: “Gutter scouts on her tail. They want the vein.”

win.text: The prospector reaches her vein · she shares the find

lose.text: You lose sight of the prospector in the dust

won.text: A rich vein was found here · nearby rocks yield more Cyrite for a while

cards.title: Break the Pirate Toll
cards.text: “A toll beacon on our lane, four ships, one captain. Drop the captain and the rest may scatter.”

lines.text: Two Gutter scouts sit with them. They heard who sold their drop.

cards.cargo: A toll beacon · four hulls at the gate

choices.label: Attack the toll crew
choices.hint: Four ships are guarding the beacon. Defeat their captain to weaken the rest.

choices.label: Jam their communications
choices.hint: Requires a jammer. Disable their comms and slip past without being detected.

win.text: The beacon goes to static · you slip by

choices.label: Take another route
choices.hint: Leave the toll beacon for now.

cards.title: Nothing to Declare
cards.text: “Custody holds the hospice ring’s medicine at the patrol line. Three ships sweeping. Slip between them, hold at the drop, then leave.”
cards.cargo: A patrol · three hulls, a crate of medicine

choices.label: Carry the medicine through
choices.hint: Avoid detection. A spoofer, ghost echo or baffles can slow the patrol’s exposure meter.

choices.label: Sell the drop to Custody
choices.hint: Custody pays 35 Cyrite. The hospice goes without, and the Gutter will know.

win.text: 35 Cyrite received · the runner will remember

choices.label: Decline the job
choices.hint: Keep your hold clear of the package.

win.text: The runner ends the call and moves on

cards.title: Follow the Cyrite Vein
cards.text: “I found a vein, and the Gutter found me. Stay on my wing until I’m there and I’ll share it.”
cards.cargo: A prospector · slow, sure of herself

choices.label: Guard the prospector
choices.hint: Stay on her wing to the vein. Keep the Gutter scouts off her.

choices.label: Take her find
choices.hint: By force: 24 Cyrite. She fights back, and the miners will hear.

win.text: Her find is yours · 24 Cyrite · the miners will hear
